title: KPI tile layout, and the Revenue and Billing Efficiency figures
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in as an owner/admin (or any user with the Reports permission) on the build under test; a single workplace is selected.
  2. A workplace with revenue and billing-efficiency data for the selected range (seed invoiced work orders with labour, and record clock hours).
custom_steps:
1. On each KPI tile, confirm it shows a label, a headline value, a sparkline, a date-range control and a report link.
2. On the Revenue tile, confirm the headline is total revenue to the cent and the supporting line reads 'Parts {parts}% · Labor {labor}%' with whole-number percents.
3. On the Billing Efficiency tile, confirm the headline is the percentage to two decimals and the supporting line reads '{invoiced hours} Invoiced / {clocked hours} Clocked'.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Each KPI tile shows a label, a headline value, a sparkline, a date-range control, and a report link.
  • The Revenue tile headline is the total revenue for the selected range, shown as a dollar amount to the cent.
  • The Revenue tile's supporting line reads "Parts {parts}% · Labor {labor}%", each percent a whole number.
  • The Billing Efficiency tile headline is the billing efficiency percentage for the selected range, to two decimal places.
  • The Billing Efficiency tile's supporting line reads "{invoiced hours} Invoiced / {clocked hours} Clocked".

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-490, story SV-9576 (S4 — KPI Hero Tiles); Dashboard v1 specification, Confluence page 788430850, section S4; read on 2 October 2026.

  • S4-R4: “The Billing Efficiency tile headline is the billing efficiency percentage for the selected range, shown to two decimal places.”
  • S4-R5: “The Billing Efficiency tile shows a supporting line reading "{invoiced hours} Invoiced / {clocked hours} Clocked".”
